questions.detail: A young infant up to 1 month of age should be given approximately 60 ml per feed, eight times per day, and a young infant between 1 and 2 months of age approximately 90 ml at each feed, seven times per day. It is helpful to have common bottles or cups…

questions.text: Ulcers or white patches in mouth
questions.detail: Look inside the mouth at the tongue and inside of the cheek. Thrush looks like milk curds on the inside of the cheek, or a thick white coating of the tongue. Try to wipe the white off. The white patches of thrush will remain.
